people.name: Moab
people.line: Ancient kingdom east of the Dead Sea in Jordan

translations.web: “Yet I will reverse the captivity of Moab in the latter days,” says Yahweh. Thus far is the judgment of Moab.
translations.bsb: Yet in the latter days I will restore Moab from captivity,” declares the LORD. Here ends the judgment on Moab.
translations.kjv: Yet will I bring again the captivity of Moab in the latter days, saith the LORD. Thus far is the judgment of Moab.
translations.asv: Yet will I bring back the captivity of Moab in the latter days, saith Jehovah. Thus far is the judgment of Moab.
